ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a slaver's ledger
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} sold people for a living: bought them cheap on the rimworlds and sold them dear in the cities, and kept a careful ledger of every profit and not one of the names.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} sold people for a living: bought them cheap in the burnt villages and sold them dear in the market towns, and kept a careful ledger of every coin and not one of the names.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} something that made {B_objective} leave the table. {B_nameDef} came back later and sat down again, without saying why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said there were things {PAWN_nameDef} never forgave {PAWN_objective}self for, and that the others should know them now:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a mercenary's contract
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: Years ago, {PAWN_nameDef} took a contract to clear a settlement off land a mining company wanted, a colony a lot like this one. {PAWN_nameDef} still remembers the color of its doors.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: Years ago, {PAWN_nameDef} took a lord's coin to clear a village off land he wanted, a settlement a lot like this one. {PAWN_nameDef} still remembers the color of its doors.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} looked at the colony's doors for a long time, then told {B_nameDef} about some other doors, a long way from here.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} painted {PAWN_nameDef}'s grave marker blue, and wouldn't say why until the paint was dry.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a back-room clinic
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} ran a back-room clinic that bought organs from the desperate and sold them to the rich, and did not always wait for the desperate to agree.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} kept a back-room surgery where the desperate sold what they could spare of themselves to the rich, and did not always wait for the desperate to agree.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} said something to {B_nameDef} in the infirmary that made {B_nameDef} go pale. They have been very careful with each other since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {PAWN_nameDef} had asked to be buried whole, every part of {PAWN_objective}, and at the graveside {TELLER_nameDef} told the others why it mattered:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a mutiny
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} led a mutiny against a cruel captain aboard a long-haul freighter, and when it was over the captain and two officers went out the airlock. The shipping company has never stopped looking for the crew.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} led a mutiny against a cruel captain on a merchant ship, and when it was over the captain and two officers went over the side. The shipowners have never stopped looking for the crew.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat up talking about captains, good ones and bad ones, until long after everyone else had gone to bed.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: Whoever is still looking for {PAWN_nameDef} can stop now, {TELLER_nameDef} said, and told the others who that was.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the last ship out
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} survived a plague that emptied a whole city, and already knew the fever had started when {PAWN_pronoun} pushed onto the last ship out. Half the passengers never walked off it.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} survived a plague that emptied a whole city, and already knew the fever had started when {PAWN_pronoun} pushed onto the last cart out through the gates. Half the people on it never climbed down.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} flinched when someone coughed at dinner. Later, out of everyone's hearing, {A_pronoun} told {B_nameDef} why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} stood at the grave a long time before speaking. {PAWN_nameDef} had carried a great many ghosts, {TELLER_pronoun} said, and it was time the others knew whose.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: an interrogator's past
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was an interrogator for a planetary regime, the one they sent for when nobody else could make a prisoner talk. It never took {PAWN_objective} more than a day.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} was the question-master in a lord's dungeon, the one they sent for when nobody else could make a prisoner talk. It never took {PAWN_objective} more than a day.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked to be kept away from the prisoners, and when {B_nameDef} asked why, told {B_objective}.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} never once raised a hand to a prisoner here, and told the others why that was harder for {PAWN_objective} than for anyone:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a guild of assassins
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: A guild of assassins raised {PAWN_nameDef} from childhood, and {PAWN_nameDef} walked out on it owing one last contract. The guild does not consider the matter closed.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} how to move through the colony at night without making a sound, and then explained where {A_pronoun} had learned it.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: The last contract will never be filled now. At the graveside, {TELLER_nameDef} told the others what it was.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the death pits
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: Forty bouts in the death pits of an urbworld, and {PAWN_nameDef} walked out of all forty. In every one of them, the other fighter never got up.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: Forty bouts in the death pits of a great city, and {PAWN_nameDef} walked out of all forty. In every one of them, the other fighter never got up.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} the scars on {A_possessive} knuckles, one at a time, and told {B_objective} where each came from.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} finally got to stay down, and told the others about the pits:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a relapse
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} swore off drugs years ago and has told everyone here so, but has been using again since the second month here, in small amounts, in the dark behind the storeroom.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {B_nameDef} found {A_nameDef} behind the storeroom one night. They talked there a long time, and walked back together.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} fought it every day here, and that the others should know how hard:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a friend's knife
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: During a famine years ago, {PAWN_nameDef}'s best friend came at {PAWN_objective} with a knife over a ration pack, and only one of them walked away. {PAWN_nameDef} still isn't sure the knife was ever meant to be used.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: During a famine years ago, {PAWN_nameDef}'s best friend came at {PAWN_objective} with a knife over a heel of bread, and only one of them walked away. {PAWN_nameDef} still isn't sure the knife was ever meant to be used.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} turned a knife over and over in {A_possessive} hands while talking to {B_nameDef}, and only put it down when the story was done.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} carried one other grave with {PAWN_objective} everywhere, and told the others whose:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a lost twin
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} had a twin who drowned the summer they turned twelve, and still sets out a second cup some mornings without thinking, then puts it away before anyone sees.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {B_nameDef} caught {A_nameDef} putting away a second cup one morning, and {A_nameDef} told {B_objective} who it was for.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} set out two cups at the funeral supper, and left the second one full.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a hidden sickness
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} has a slow sickness that no doctor out here could cure, and has been hiding the bad days behind long shifts and a steady smile.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} sat down hard after a long shift, and when {B_nameDef} asked, didn't wave it away for once.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said the long shifts and the steady smile were hiding something, all along:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the only survivor
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} came from a colony a lot like this one, and was the only one left alive when the raiders were done with it. {PAWN_nameDef} still knows every name, and says them some nights, in order.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} a list of names one evening, slowly, all of them. {B_nameDef} listened to every one.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} read out a list of names at the graveside, slowly, all of them, from memory.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a dog left behind
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} once left a dog tied to a post in a burning town, because there was no room left on the ship. {PAWN_nameDef} can still hear it barking.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} knelt to scratch a dog's ears for a long time, and afterwards told {B_nameDef} about another dog.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said there was a dog the others ought to know about.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: letters to the dead
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: Once a week, {PAWN_nameDef} writes to a spouse who died years ago, about the weather and the crops and everyone here. The letters go in a box under the bed, and the box is nearly full.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} how to spell something, and then, a little embarrassed, who the letter was for.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} put a box of letters in the grave with {PAWN_nameDef}, and told the others who they were for:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the strays at the fence
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: Every night for weeks, {PAWN_nameDef} has been slipping scraps to the wild animals by the fence. Several of them now come running at a particular whistle.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef} out to the fence at dusk and whistled. {B_nameDef} came back grinning and wouldn't say why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} went out to the fence at dusk after the burial, whistled the way {PAWN_nameDef} used to, and waited.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a hidden garden
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} has been growing flowers in a forgotten corner behind the walls, from a pouch of seeds carried all the way from home, and visits them every morning before anyone else is up.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: Before breakfast, {A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef} somewhere behind the walls. {B_nameDef} came back with a flower behind {B_possessive} ear.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} brought flowers to the grave that nobody had seen growing anywhere in the colony, and told the others where they came from:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a famous song
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was a famous musician on a glitterworld, with a song that still plays on the long-range bands, and walked off the stage at the height of it without ever telling anyone why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} was a famous minstrel once, with a song still sung in taverns three kingdoms away, and walked out of a lord's hall at the height of it without ever telling anyone why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} hummed a few bars of something for {B_nameDef}, then stopped and went red. {B_nameDef} can't get the tune out of {B_possessive} head.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} sang a song at the graveside that a few of the others half recognized.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: songs for the crops
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} sings to the crops every morning, row by row, under {PAWN_possessive} breath and badly, always the same three songs.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {B_nameDef} caught {A_nameDef} at something in the fields at dawn, and has been very amused about it ever since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: The morning after the burial, {TELLER_nameDef} went out to the fields at dawn and sang, badly, the same three songs.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a book of birthdays
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} keeps a small book of everyone's birthdays, favorite foods and the names of the people they lost, and has made sure that no one's birthday has gone unmarked since {PAWN_pronoun} arrived.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} a very casual question about {B_possessive} family, and wrote something down afterwards in a small book.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} brought a small book to the grave and read a little from it, then told the others what it was:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: someone else's cooking
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} can't cook at all. Every fine meal {PAWN_pronoun} ever took credit for was made by someone else, and {PAWN_possessive} own attempts are buried in a pit behind the kitchen.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} for help in the kitchen, privately, and swore {B_objective} to silence before the first pot was on.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} cooked the funeral supper, and said it was the one meal {PAWN_nameDef} would never get the credit for:
